hints: PATH-LIGHTS costs 20 and LIFT-POWER costs 35: together they use 55/60.
Leave AUX-POWER off. Launch, then walk right three times.

tutorial_steps.title: Your power console
tutorial_steps.explanation: The generator can supply 60 units at once. This is a simultaneous limit, not a battery that drains. Let us deliberately try a configuration that is too large.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press E to open the console.

tutorial_steps.title: Choose path lights
tutorial_steps.explanation: PATH LIGHTS costs 20 units. It lights the pad and the floor on the route. Space changes the pending selection; Enter applies it.
tutorial_steps.objective: Use Up/Down to select PATH-LIGHTS, then Space to switch it on.

tutorial_steps.title: Choose lift power
tutorial_steps.explanation: LIFT POWER costs 35 units. It lights the exit and supplies the elevator. Together with PATH LIGHTS, it uses 55 of 60 units.
tutorial_steps.objective: Use Up/Down to select LIFT-POWER, then Space to switch it on.

tutorial_steps.title: Choose aux power
tutorial_steps.explanation: AUX POWER costs 15 units and does not help this route. Turn it on for this experiment: the pending total becomes 70 of 60.
tutorial_steps.objective: Use Up/Down to select AUX-POWER, then Space to switch it on.

tutorial_steps.title: Try the budget limit
tutorial_steps.explanation: 70 exceeds the 60-unit capacity. Try applying it to see the rejection. The game will refuse the whole configuration: no power changes, no turn passes, and the echo cannot advance.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press Enter to try applying 70/60 units.

tutorial_steps.title: Choose what you need
tutorial_steps.explanation: That request was rejected. Disable AUX POWER so the essential route lights and elevator fit: 20 + 35 = 55. Over-budget choices are never silently reduced.
tutorial_steps.objective: Select AUX POWER, then Space to switch it off.

tutorial_steps.title: Apply a safe allocation
tutorial_steps.explanation: 55 fits within 60. Power and pad activation are separate requirements: a powered elevator still waits for its linked pad.

tutorial_steps.title: Start a take
tutorial_steps.explanation: Enter begins recording at the hub. Only accepted moves and waits are saved. For this movement lesson, we will save no commands; useful recordings come in the recording chamber.

tutorial_steps.title: Save the empty take
tutorial_steps.explanation: Enter again saves the take and returns you to the start. An empty take stores no movement. We use it here to enter replay and practice walking safely.

tutorial_steps.title: Launch and start playing
tutorial_steps.explanation: Q at the hub starts replay. You return to the chamber start; pads reset and selected power stays on. The blue echo has no commands in this lesson.

tutorial_steps.title: Activate a timed pad
tutorial_steps.explanation: Step onto pad A to activate the elevator. Occupying the pad sets its timer to 3. Space waits one turn; waiting also advances an active echo and unoccupied pad timers.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press Right or D onto pad A.

tutorial_steps.title: Watch the countdown
tutorial_steps.explanation: Leave pad A for the lit floor. Its timer will decrease from 3 to 2 at the end of this turn. Hover the pad or use T help to inspect occupied, active and remaining timer separately.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press Right or D onto the lit floor.

tutorial_steps.title: Use the active window
tutorial_steps.explanation: The pad is empty but remains active with timer 2. Reach the powered elevator before the timer reaches zero. This move leaves timer 1, so the elevator still runs.
tutorial_steps.objective: Press Right or D into the elevator.

lesson_summary: You tested the capacity limit and chose 55/60 units. Power is a simultaneous limit, and a timed pad can stay active after you leave it.
